Game Overview

Build a Burger is a casual title where dive into burger madness as you dash forward, snatching ingredients to craft epic burgers. Dodge quirky obstacles while mixing up unique recipes, and watch your culinary creation grow to ridiculous sizes. Unlock bonuses and savor the glory as you serve the ultimate giant burger feast!
